questions.q: What two things does two-way matching compare between the invoice and the purchase order?
options: Quantity and unit price
Receipt date and invoice date
Supplier name and PO number only
Tax amount and freight amount
questions.explain: Two-way matching checks invoiced quantity against ordered quantity, and invoiced price against ordered price — nothing else.

questions.q: What does two-way matching never check?
options: The unit price on the PO line
The quantity ordered on the PO line
Whether a receipt confirms the goods arrived
Whether the invoice references a PO at all
questions.explain: Two-way matching has no receipt step. Confirming physical or service receipt is what three-way and four-way matching add.

questions.q: Which kind of purchase order is the best fit for two-way matching?
options: A one-time purchase order for a consulting services engagement
A high-value capital equipment order requiring inspection
A raw-materials order where exact quantities received must be verified
An order where receiving is mandatory for regulatory reasons
questions.explain: Services and low-risk indirect purchases, where a formal receiving step adds little value, are the classic fit for two-way matching.

questions.q: In the Cascade Industrial Parts example, the invoice price is $12.95 against an ordered price of $12.50. With a 5% price tolerance, what happens?
options: The invoice is automatically cancelled
The invoice is rejected and sent back to the supplier
The invoice clears matching because the variance is within tolerance
The invoice is placed on a price hold regardless of tolerance
questions.explain: The variance (about 3.6%) is inside the 5% tolerance, so the invoice passes the price check without a hold.

questions.q: What is the purpose of a matching tolerance?
options: It defines how long a supplier has to pay back an overpayment
It defines how much variance between PO and invoice is allowed before a hold is created
It sets the number of approval levels an invoice must pass through
It determines which bank account a payment is disbursed from
questions.explain: Tolerances let small, expected variances through automatically while still catching variances large enough to warrant review.
